claims: The Oscars are held at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, California.
The Dolby Theatre has served as the permanent home of the Academy Awards ceremony since 2001.
The Dolby Theatre is located at Ovation Hollywood on Hollywood Boulevard.
The Dolby Theatre is located at 6801 Hollywood Blvd, Hollywood, CA 90028.
The Dolby Theatre was formerly known as the Kodak Theater.
The Dolby Theatre was explicitly built to host the Academy Awards ceremony, according to the Dolby Theatre website.
The Dolby Theatre is located in a complex containing retail shops and restaurants, notes the Facebook post from Entertainment Weekly.
The Dolby Theatre is directly connected to the historic TCL Chinese Theatre, notes the Facebook post from Entertainment Weekly.
The Dolby Theatre is scheduled to host the Academy Awards through 2028.
Academy-managed spaces include the David Geffen Theater and Ted Mann Theater.
The Dolby Theatre is the primary venue for the televised Academy Awards show, according to the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
